I farm here in Amhara on the flat lands where the water sits, and rice grows well when the rains come good. My plot is small, only a quarter hectare, but rice needs care — I will put some DAP and urea like the cooperative teaches, and also spread manure from my animals to help the soil. I have heard the improved rice seed gives better yield, and my neighbors have used it, so I will plant that too. Weeding takes many hands for rice, so my family will work hard and I will hire a few people at weeding and harvest time.
